scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @smartkid/server" "npm run dev -w @smartkid/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @smartkid/shared && npm run build -w @smartkid/server && npm run build -w @smartkid/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @smartkid/shared && npm run typecheck -w @smartkid/server && npm run typecheck -w @smartkid/client
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
